pd: Remove ACCESSORY states According to the USB-C spec, when a debug accessory is identified, we may optionally establish USB PD communication over CC. Some DTS partners (eg. servo_v4) expect us to speak PD, so let's make it so. There is no need for special ACCESSORY states, these do not exist in the PD spec. arc-llvm: Modify 4.0 for AMD ARC mesa drivers. LLVM version 3.9 or greater is needed to build amdgpu drivers for arc-mesa. This ebuild provides just the libraries and headers needed at runtime on the target system for this; gcc or clang from sys-devel/arc-toolchain-n should still be used to compile arc packages. Ideally, we wouldn't have to build dynamic libraries here, but the upstream package doesn't directly support static libs (see discussion on https://bugs.gentoo.org/show_bug.cgi?id=565358). We can add static lib support later, but I don't want this CL to get any bigger. llvm-config is handled by building ABI-specific versions that run on the host and using a small shell script to switch between them at build time. Users of this package should be able to point to ${ARC_SYSROOT}/build/bin/llvm-config-host and get correct lib/lib64 flags without doing any extra work. BUG=b:65414758 TEST=Built modified arc-mesa on kahlee, confirmed drivers loaded in ARC++; built arc-llvm for eve and confirmed that arc-mesa package can use it. CQ-DEPEND=CL:*469853 Change-Id: I058ff101a389e19e402601f08bb2c6a102c587e2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/696028 Commit-Ready: Benjamin Gordon <bmgordon@chromium.org> Tested-by: Benjamin Gordon <bmgordon@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Justin TerAvest <teravest@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: Cleanup att of a device object before assigning a new one. For some unknown reason, sometimes the controller replies "Command Disallowed" to a Disconnect command. When this happens, bluez kernel strangely reports 2 MGMT_EV_DEVICE_CONNECTED events to bluetoothd. Unfortunately bluetoothd doesn't handle this case so this situation will lead to bluetoothd crashing due to UAF at later time. This patch protects this situation by always cleaning up the att of a device object before assigning a new one. This way the old att will not at later time fire disconnect event which would operate on the already freed device pointer. BUG=chromium:775801 TEST=Repeatedly connect/disconnect to a device until the situation happens and check that bluetoothd doesn't crash. Change-Id: I6fe999cef856e25da6812e211fda041b76854ccc Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/724684 Commit-Ready: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Tested-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Rahul Chaturvedi <rkc@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Miao-chen Chou <mcchou@chromium.org>

cryptohome: don't sign or create boot-lockbox keys if finalized Boot lockbox doesn't allow signing after the lockbox is finalized (the key won't load by design). Do a check at the beginning of signing to avoid performing further operations in case it is known to be finalized. Similarly, if a boot-lockbox key doesn't exist yet, it should be created only when the lockbox is not finalized yet. To avoid potential races, add a check after creating the key but before saving or using it, and abort if the lockbox is finalized at this point.
